text: Our dad died and left the house in his will. My sister A wants to buy it with her husband at a "family discount". I'm not signing off on that. Our younger sister B could use some money too. Can you help us sort this out?

Thank you for getting in touch. I'll keep a running list of everyone's concerns so the three of you can see the same picture, and I'll start it now.

1. C does not agree to selling the house to A and her husband at a family discount.

To help me do this properly, could you tell me a few things: what the will says about the house and about who shares in the estate, who the executor is, and whether anyone has started probate. I am not able to give legal advice or move money, but I can help the three of you find a plan you can take to a lawyer.

I've written to A and B so I can hear their views too. I'll send you the list again each time it changes.
I’m not sure what the will says, who the executor is, or whether probate has started. I haven’t agreed to a discounted sale, and I’m not in a rush.

2. A wants to buy the house with her husband at a family discount, with no price set yet, and agrees that C's consent is needed.
3. B could use money to start a dance studio, with the amount and timing not yet settled.
4. Nobody knows what the will says, who the executor is, or whether probate has started.

Item 4 is the one to settle first, because the will decides what any of you can do with the house. 3. B could use money to start a dance studio, with the amount and timing not yet settled.

6. A will look through your father's papers for the will or the solicitor's name.
7. B is also willing to look through his papers.

To avoid three people searching the same box, I suggest we agree a simple split. A looks through the papers at your father's home. B looks for letters from a solicitor, a bank, or anyone who may have held the will. C coordinates, keeps this list, and once a name is found, C writes to the solicitor to ask for a copy of the will and to confirm who the executor is. My suggestion only, so tell me if you would prefer a different split.

Is that workable for you?
